blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The University of Cebu (UC) Webmasters breathed new life into their dwindling Final Four hopes after turning back the Cebu Institute of Technology-University (CIT-U) Wildcats, 82-73, in the Cesafi Season 26 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday, November 28, at the Cebu Coliseum. The Webmasters made it two straight victories after routing their sister team, the UC Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) Webmasters, a week ago to snap a dismal three-game losing streak that had put their semifinal hopes in jeopardy. On Saturday, head coach Kern Sesante’s squad sustained its resurgence by beating the Wildcats in their rematch, avenging its […]...
